payload.description:
As a platform operator, I want Tactus-based scores to use recorded Deepgram item attachments for evidence timestamp enrichment, so that asynchronous score results retain timestamp fields without requiring inline Deepgram metadata.

Feature: Tactus attachment timestamp enrichment

Scenario: Tactus score enriches evidence from recorded attachment key
Given a Tactus score result explanation contains quoted evidence
And scoring metadata includes an attached Deepgram JSON key
When the score enriches the explanation
Then it loads the Deepgram data from that attachment key
And the returned score result includes start and end timestamp seconds.
payload.title: Tactus scores use attached Deepgram evidence
